published_ranges._notes: Bio-based compound, semi-matte. Shrinkage 0.4%. Catalogue print settings are for a 0.4 mm nozzle, max 50% layer height. Diameter not stated in the catalogue, so filament_diameter is left unset.

conflicts: Density: the 2018 Extrudr GreenTEC Pro material data sheet (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0622/4181/files/materialdatasheet-greentecpro_1.pdf) prints 1,39 g/cm3; the current catalogue gives 1.35.
